description: Same live test as benchmark, but on the models the person names (model_ids). Needs a finished discover session so every requirement is judged. Estimate first, then go=true.

current_model.description: OpenRouter id of the model the job uses now, if any.

go.description: The person approved the estimate. Spends on their key.

model_ids.description: The OpenRouter ids of the models the person named.

offer.description: The offer from the estimate. Pass it with go=true to run.

overruled.description: Failures the person accepts, as 'model id|requirement words'.

ratings.description: Blind ratings: {task id: {letter: good|ok|poor}}, with test_session.

runs_per_month.description: Roughly how many times a month the job runs, if known.

session.description: The sealed session from a finished discover conversation.

tasks.description: The person's real work to test on, real examples first. Write extra tasks yourself only for the gaps XFMS names, with source 'made up'. Images as data URLs.

covers.description: ids of the requirements this task tests

group.description: optional kind of task, e.g. 'short captions'

test_session.description: From a finished run, to overrule failures without rerunning.

name: compare

outputSchema.description: Same as benchmark, for the models the person named.

title: Test models the person named on their own work
